title: Blitzgiving
cn: 第 10 集 · 闪电感恩节
novel: Ted left the bar early on the night before Thanksgiving to prepare a [[lavish|lavish]] dinner for his friends. He had been planning the meal for weeks and wanted everything to be [[perfect|perfect]]. However, the moment Ted walked out, the gang met a man called The Blitz. The Blitz was a college friend cursed with [[terrible|terrible]] luck. Whenever he left a room, something [[amazing|amazing]] happened, and he always missed it. This curse was known as the Blitz [[curse|curse]]. Steve, the current Blitz, joined the group and immediately brought his bad luck with him. The gang had an [[incredible|incredible]] night at the bar. They met celebrities, won free drinks, and laughed until dawn. But Steve missed every single [[spectacular|spectacular]] moment because he kept stepping outside. The next morning, Ted [[slaved|slave]] away in the kitchen. He [[roasted|roast]] a turkey, [[mashed|mash]] potatoes, and baked three different pies. But when his friends finally arrived, they were [[exhausted|exhaust]] from the night before and barely had any [[appetite|appetite]]. Ted was [[furious|furious]]. He felt that his hard work was being [[ignored|ignore]]. To make matters worse, the curse of the Blitz [[transferred|transfer]] to Ted. Every time he left the kitchen, something exciting happened in the living room. Ted finally understood how [[frustrating|frustrate]] the curse could be. Eventually, Steve left the apartment, and the curse returned to him. The gang sat down together and [[enjoyed|enjoy]] the Thanksgiving meal. Ted realized that the most important thing was not the food but being [[surrounded|surround]] by the people he loved. They raised their glasses and gave thanks for their [[friendship|friendship]].

lavish.en: very expensive and impressive in scale

curse.en: a magic spell that brings bad luck

incredible.en: impossible or very hard to believe

spectacular.en: very impressive and exciting to watch

slave.en: to work extremely hard at something

roast.en: to cook food in an oven with heat

mash.en: to crush food until it is soft and smooth

exhaust.en: to make someone feel completely tired

ignore.en: to pay no attention to something

transfer.en: to move from one person to another

frustrate.en: to make someone feel upset or blocked

surround.en: to be all around someone or something
